# Spring Hill English Boarding School (SHEBS)

> A school at Nala, Banepa-4, Kavrepalanchok, Nepal, providing education from Play Group / Pre-School to Class 12 since 2045 B.S. (1988 AD).

## Key facts

- Name: Spring Hill English Boarding School. Also known as SHEBS, Spring Hill School.
- Established: 2045 B.S. (1988 AD). More than 35 years of teaching.
- Location: Nala, Banepa-4, Kavrepalanchok (Kavre) district, Nepal.
- Classes: Pre-School (Montessori method), Basic Level (Grades 1–5), Secondary (Grades 6–10), +2 (Grades 11–12).
- Students: 1,500+.
- Principal: Sundar Budathoki.
- Facilities: classrooms, science laboratories, computer centres, library and study zones, sports and recreational spaces.
- Office and admission desk: Sunday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
- Phone: +977-9841103044, +977-9860865441. WhatsApp: +977-9841103044.
- Email: springhill607@gmail.com
- Mobile app: "Spring Hill E.B.S." on the App Store and Google Play.

## Admissions

Admissions are in person at the Nala campus, no appointment needed: visit to collect the admission kit, meet a counsellor, take a short friendly entrance assessment, then complete the paperwork and pay the fees. Bring the originals and one set of photocopies of the Transfer Certificate, the last marksheet, a character certificate, two passport-sized photographs and a photocopy of the birth certificate.
